name: step-invalidation
title: Step Invalidation
description: Wizard helper that says exactly what a change to an earlier answer clears ("Changing plan to Basic clears Region on step 3…") before applying it, marks affected steps, reviews only them and holds Finish until they're checked; changing back restores what was removed.

meta.stops: Earlier wizard change broke later steps
meta.summary: Says which later wizard answers an earlier change will clear before it applies, then walks back through only those steps.
catches: Later answers a change would clear or trim, grouped by step
Steps needing review, marked in the stepper
Finish attempted before affected steps are checked
Changing the answer back, which restores what was removed
limits: Dependencies are what you declare in the wizard config
Restore works within the session; it isn't persisted
a11y: Stepper buttons use aria-current="step" and aria-labels that include the stale hint
Keep, change and review are labelled buttons; icons are aria-hidden
